facility.name: Little Hawks Early Childhood Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Five out of ten staff files were missing documentation showing how the employee meets the minimum age and education qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The parent handbook did not include information about the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity including the benefits of physical activity and outdoor play, the type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in, each setting in which your physical activity program will take place; criteria you will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play, and A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One out of nine staff were missing training for emergency preparedness, preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, administrering medication. Thw out of nine staff were missing training for  preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, understanding building and physical premises safety, and handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director was missing training for emergency preparedness, preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, administrering medication,  preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, understanding building and physical premises safety, and handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Field Trips: Information regarding field trip procedures were not included in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Field Trips (26 TAC §746.501(a)(16))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Six out of ten staff files were missing a Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations (Form 2912).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Parent rights were not observed in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The wooden boarder on the outdoor play area was raised presenting a possible tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Transportation: Information regarding transportation procedures was not observed to be in the parent handbook.

Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Four out of ten staff members were missing a notarized Affidavit for Applicants for Employment with a Licensed Operation or Registered Child-Care Home (Form 2985).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification: Three out of ten staff files were missing a copy of a photo identification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguishers in the operation's vehicles were not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: The operation uses two vehicles for transportation. One vehicle had all the required information for both vehicles. Each vehicle should have information for the children that they are transporting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Five children's admission files were lacking current immunization records.
Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children's enrollment information was lacking current immunization records.
Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies were lacking information related to the promotion of physical activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant feeding schedule has not been updated within the past 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
